    T3. Forward-looking reporting long-term risks (next quarters/years) [YES] — ECB projected rate path to mid-2027, luxury sector recovery outlook, Soitec revenue outlook to 2027

Synopsis:
    European equities rebounded modestly (+0.5% STOXX 600) after three down sessions, as bond yields pulled back from multi-year highs. The Iran war-driven oil spike (above $95/bbl) remains the dominant macro overhang, stoking inflation fears and keeping central banks hawkish. The ECB is widely expected to hike to 2.5% next week with further tightening priced through mid-2027. Fed Chair Warsh's hawkish tone last week has markets braced for continued US rate hikes; Friday's NFP is the next key catalyst. Sector highlights: Soitec surged on upgraded revenue outlook; luxury names (LVMH, Hermes, Kering) underperformed; WPP and Publicis rose on a media account win; Commerzbank gained on a buyback; Deutsche Telekom rose on Elliott's stake.
